Never the raw content: ``ref`` is an id/URI pointer and ``digest`` is a
content hash (e.g. ``sha256:...``). Store one or both; the raw
counterparty prompt or model output stays out of the record.

Money.description:
Exact money amount in integer micros (flagged decision FD-11).

``1_000_000`` micros = 1 currency unit — the ad-industry convention
(Google Ad Manager, among others, prices in micros). Float is BANNED on
the wire for money: IEEE 754 floating point is non-deterministic for
money math (``0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3``, and repeated CPM — cost per mille —
arithmetic accumulates error), and the two source repos used ``float``
end-to-end; that defect must not be fossilized into the spec. Every
price, rate, budget, and offer in the shared contract is a ``Money``.

``amount_micros`` is a strict integer: float inputs are rejected at
validation time rather than silently truncated.

amount_micros.description: Amount in micros; 1,000,000 micros = 1 currency unit.
amount_micros.title: Amount Micros

description:
A durable record of why a money/state decision was made (EP-10.1).

Persisted domain object (distinct from the transient Event envelope).
References its subject by id — it is never embedded on the Deal/Order/
Quote; those objects point back to nothing, and the audit store joins
on ``subject_id`` / ``correlation_id``.

ID minting: ``decision_id`` is minted by the agent that made the
decision when the record is written to its audit store.

decision_id.description: Id of this decision record (minted by the decider).
decision_id.title: Decision Id

inputs.description: References/hashes of the counterparty inputs and model outputs that drove the decision (never raw prompts).
inputs.title: Inputs

money_effect.description: Money movement this decision caused, if any (exact micros; FD-11).

negotiation_id.description: Negotiation the decision belongs to, if any.
negotiation_id.title: Negotiation Id

occurred_at.description: Timezone-aware UTC timestamp of when the decision was made.
occurred_at.title: Occurred At

session_id.description: Session the decision occurred in, if any.
session_id.title: Session Id

subject_id.description: Id of the deal/quote/order/... the decision concerns.
subject_id.title: Subject Id
